newsitem.title: USA: Resource America offers $75 mln of notes.
newsitem.headline: Resource America offers $75 mln of notes.

text.p: Resource America Inc said on Tuesday it had commenced a private offering of $75 million of its senior notes, due 2004.
The offering will be made only to qualified institutional buyers and selected accredited investors, the company said.
The interest rate for the senior notes will be established prior to the close of the offering, Resource America said.
Resource America may not redeem the senior notes prior to 2002, and thereafter may redeem them at specified premiums to par, the company said.

Upon a change of control, holders may require the company to repurchase the senior notes at a price of 101 percent of the principal amount, plus accrued interest to the repurchase date, Resource America said.
It is anticipated that the offering will close on or about July 15, 1997, the company said.

Proceeds will be used by the company to repay approximately $21.4 million of existing debt, to expand its real estate loan acquisition and resolution operations, to expand its equipment leasing operations and for other general corporate purposes, Resource America said.
